principles: Tactical Minimalism: Replace soft shadows with 1px solid strokes or inner glow highlights.
High-Visibility: Command-center focus, utilizing Deep Obsidian anchor with Electric Red triggers.
Data Density: Modular bento-grid layouts for performance metrics to mimic pro sports dashboards.

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Tailwind standard (p-4, p-6, p-8, p-12). Use generous spacing around macro sections.

grid_strategy.results: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-6 (Control Room Grid - Dense and actionable)

buttons.primary: bg-[#E60000] text-white hover:bg-[#FF1A1A] font-heading text-xl uppercase tracking-wider rounded-none border border-transparent transition-all
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent text-white border border-white/20 hover:border-white/50 font-heading text-xl uppercase tracking-wider rounded-none transition-all

cards.style: bg-[#141414] border border-white/10 rounded-none p-6 md:p-8 relative overflow-hidden

inputs.style: bg-[#0A0A0A] border-b border-white/20 rounded-none px-4 py-3 text-white focus:border-[#E60000] focus:ring-0 transition-colors placeholder:text-gray-600

surface_effects: The 'Technical' Look: Grid borders visible. Data-heavy sections should feel like a skeletal grid.
Minimal Glass: Use backdrop-blur sparingly, only for sticky headers. bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/10.

images.description: Dark, moody gym shot of a man lifting a barbell. Apply heavy black overlay (bg-black/70) so text is highly legible.
images.usage: Hero section background with parallax or subtle zoom effect.

icons.style: Sharp, 1.5px stroke width. Use red accent for key metric icons.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Buttons and interactive cards must have noticeable hover states (border glow or color shift).
motion_and_interactions.transitions: Fast and snappy. 150ms ease-out. No slow, sluggish fades.
motion_and_interactions.entrance: Staggered fade-up for form fields and result widgets.

technical_requirements.components_library: Shadcn UI (heavily customized to remove rounded corners and soft shadows)
technical_requirements.accessibility: Ensure all form inputs have proper labels. Maintain 4.5:1 contrast for text.
technical_requirements.testing: Add data-testid to all interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='calculate-btn').

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the 'IRON CALCULATOR' hero section with the provided unsplash background image and heavy black overlay.
Create the user profile form (gender, age, height, weight, activity level, goal, workouts/week). Use sharp, squared-off inputs.
Calculate BMR using Mifflin-St Jeor, then TDEE, then adjust based on goals (Cut -20%, Maintain 0%, Bulk +10/15%).
Calculate Macros: Protein 2g/kg, Fat 0.9g/kg, Carbs fill the rest of the calories.
Display results in a 'Control Room' style dashboard. Big typography for total calories.
Implement a Recharts donut or bar chart for the macro split using the specified chart colors.
Include personalized nutrition tips based on the selected goal.
Implement light/dark theme toggle, but default to DARK mode.
Use LocalStorage to save the last calculated result.
Ensure the UI uses 'Bebas Neue' for big, impactful headings and 'Inter' for readable body text. Add the Google Fonts import to the index.html or css.
